role: TGA packages express Trust Graph-derived governance patterns using TSMM v0.25.0 canonical semantics while preserving essay provenance and implementation evidence as repository-specific surfaces.

maps.notes: TGA controls are package-local projections of TSMM authority origin, delegation, attenuation, scope, status, and revocation semantics.
TGA constraints define implementation pressure while TSMM remains authoritative for policy and admitted-effect semantics.
Essay provenance is design provenance; runtime evidence is represented using TSMM evidence and assessment semantics and may be serialized through TIS.
TGA receipt examples profile canonical TSMM decision/effect semantics and do not establish a competing decision model.
TGA temporal-governance artifacts apply TSMM lifecycle semantics to implementation and assurance cases.
TGA contestability patterns operationalize TSMM redress semantics without moving semantic authority into TGA.
TGA posture labels are contextual. Executable assurance rigor remains governed by explicit portable assurance contracts such as TIS AL1-AL4.
